The sample is the Pbnm phase coexisting with Cmcm post-perovskite after laser-heated synthesis from natural orthopyroxene. The 163.3(1) A^3 recovered-sample volume is measured, but no composition-specific positional refinement or trace-site partition is published; pure-MgSiO3 positions are therefore an explicit topology proxy.
